display.description: Name of the X display to use.

verbose.description: Print more messages to the console.

quiet.description: Print fewer messages to the console.

window_count.description: Number of dock windows to open.

show_window_ids.description: Print the window's index number on the window.

fill_rows.description: Fill the top row of each dock window before placing any icons in the second row.

foreground_color.description: Color for the page indicator and --id-windows indicators.

background_color.description: Color for the window background in non-Window Maker mode. Empty uses ParentRelative.
